canary_semantics: positive changes one named hidden coordinate; canary keeps it fixed (clock canary changes raw direction to verify discrimination)
claim: A source-clock difference persists but does not alter the raw singleton trajectory in the frozen panel.
falsifier: clock-only pair changes raw trajectory or raw-difference canary is missed
fresh_world_rule: OS-entropy seed; admissible N/geometry/range fixed by challenge generator
metric: exact family predicate; no fitted tolerance
prediction: raw trajectories equal and clock trajectories differ; raw-direction canary is detected as divergent
threshold: all three fresh trials and their paired canaries pass
